gloss: view of life; philosophy of life

definitions.gloss: view of life; philosophy of life; outlook on life
definitions.explanation: One's fundamental beliefs and attitudes about life, its meaning, and how it should be lived. A person's overall perspective on what matters in life.

examples.japanese: {人生観|じんせいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人生観|じんせいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Travel broadens your outlook on life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人生観|じんせいかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: They say his outlook on life changed greatly after experiencing a serious illness.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧ (life, human life) + {観|かん} (view, outlook). The suffix ～{観|かん} is productive and creates many similar compound nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人生観|じんせいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: one's outlook on life changes
- {人生観|じんせいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have an outlook on life
- {人生観|じんせいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to influence one's view of life

RELATED ～{観|かん} COMPOUNDS:

- ⟦{死生観|しせいかん}→死生観：21811_shiseikan⟧: view of life and death
